en: Colorized postcard view of a large sanatorium building with steep red-tiled roofs and white walls, surrounded by lawns, flowerbeds, and trees. A long, low gallery-like wing extends in front of the main building. The sky is blue with scattered clouds, and a small airship or dirigible appears above the roof. At the top of the image, printed text identifies the place as "Bad Elster" and the facility as "Dr. Köhlers Sanatorium."
